title: Metabolic Syndrome Care Guidance
source: IDF / Harmonized Consensus Criteria for Metabolic Syndrome in South Asians
reviewed_by: Dr. A. Sharma, MD (Endocrinology Review Board)

doctor_tests: Annual preventive metabolic screening (BP, waist, fasting glucose, lipids)
food: Whole-food, fiber-rich diet with limited refined carbohydrates

doctor_tests: Physician or Endocrinologist review within 2–4 weeks
Fasting Lipid Profile, Fasting Glucose, HbA1c, and Liver Ultrasound
exercise: 200 minutes/week of combined aerobic + resistance training
food: Target 5–7% gradual weight reduction if overweight
Eliminate sugary beverages and trans fats
moderate.hospital_guidance: Diabetes / Metabolic Clinic with diagnostic lab.

doctor_tests: Endocrinologist / Internal Medicine consultation within 1–2 weeks
Full Metabolic Panel, HbA1c, Lipid Profile, LFT, and Cardiovascular Risk Review
exercise: Get medical clearance first if blood pressure or cardiac risk is also elevated.
food: Medical nutrition therapy targeting abdominal obesity, triglycerides, and glycemic control
high.hospital_guidance: Multi-specialty center with Endocrinology, Cardiology, and Nutrition support.
